messages:
Maria: ok team — quick sync thread. we need to lock recruitment signals + launch criteria for the pilot we're calling 'Signal Orchestration' (working name). goal: 8–12 partners, 6 week pilot, clear pass/fail metrics. thoughts?
Kevin: timeline ok. coupling questions: do we recruit by use case (embeddings/rerank/generation) or by infra (private vs hosted)?
Maria: prefer use case buckets first. we can map infra later for dedicated/private customers. intent is to validate routing + fallback policies.
Sam: +1 use-case focus. want a lightweight screening that captures: primary use case, average QPS, latency tolerance, and success metric.
Lina: can we add 'current infra constraints' checkbox — e.g., on-prem, VPC, hosted only. helps prioritize Dedicated candidates.
Maria: yes. rough screening Qs in draft: ```1) primary use case (gen/emb/rerank) 2) avg daily requests 3) p50/p95 latency requirement 4) data-sensitivity (public/internal/regulated) 5) willingness for short telemetry hooks (yes/no)```
Kevin: looks good. add one: 'can you commit to weekly feedback sessions (30m)' — want consistent eval cadence.
Sam: for success metrics suggestion: 1) latency SLO meeting < target for 90% of traffic 2) regression-free outputs on core prompts (measured by small eval set) 3) cost per 1k tokens within baseline +/- 20%
Lina: operational acceptance: onboarding time < 2 weeks, and runbook completeness for handoff. also we should define rollback criteria if latency regressions hit production.
Maria: rollback criteria proposal: if p95 latency increases > 40% vs baseline for 2 consecutive days OR error rate > 3% for >1 hour -> auto-fallback to last stable model/route.
opsbot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary windows available Thu 10:00-12:00 UTC and Tue 16:00-18:00 UTC.
Kevin: good. recruitment signals: prioritize customers with (a) representative traffic, (b) clear success metric owner, (c) low compliance friction. we should score candidates and pick top 12.
Sam: scoring rubric idea (0-3 each): representativeness, engagement likelihood, infra fit, and telemetry access. threshold >=9 to include.
Lina: append legal gating: if regulated data involved mark as 'private-only' and route to SE for contract check.
Maria: agreed. action items: Kevin to draft screening form + rubric by Fri; Sam to assemble eval prompt set (10 prompts per use case) by Fri; Lina to draft onboarding checklist + legal flag flow by Mon. I'll compile candidate intake sheet and start outreach next week.
Kevin: I'll post the Google Form link here when ready.
Sam: can we run a tiny dry-run with internal teammates to validate the eval set? volunteer list: @Kevin, @Lina, me.
Lina: count me in.
Maria: thanks — short follow-up call Wed 10am to finalize. please react with :thumbsup: if you can make it or say otherwise.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Lina: :thumbsup:
Maria: will upload intake sheet + timeline doc after the call.
Maria: (later) uploaded intake sheet: https://docs.google.com/xyz — candidate columns: company, contact, use_case, qps, latency_target, infra, eval_owner, legal_flag, score
Kevin: saw it, left a few comments. small nit: add column 'preferred rollout window' so we can match canary windows.
Maria: done. thanks.
Maria: closing notes: keep recruitment narrow — we want high-signal partners not big vanity names. prioritize likelihood of actionable feedback on routing/caching behavior.
Sam: noted. excited to get this running.
